features: Wireless Charging On-the-Go: Experience true convenience with built-in 15W wireless fast charging. Simply place your Qi-enabled phone on the surface—no cables, no clutter, just seamless power.
Massive 20000mAh Capacity: This high-capacity wireless power bank lets you charge smartphones, tablets, earbuds, and more multiple times—ideal for travel, work, or emergency use.
22.5W Dual Output for Fast Charging: Features USB and Type-C outputs with 22.5W total output for lightning-fast wired charging across Android, iOS, and other USB-C devices.
Magnetic Wireless Power Bank with Built-in Cable: Comes with a magnetic ring for secure wireless charging and an inbuilt Type-C cable, so you’re never caught without the right connector.
Digital LED Display for Real-Time Status: Stay informed with a crisp LED display showing exact battery percentage and charging status—no guessing needed.
Premium Design, Compact Build: Inspired by camera aesthetics, Power Shutter 20K is sleek, modern, and highly portable. Carry style and functionality in your pocket or bag.
Safe & Reliable Charging Anywhere: Features multi-layer circuit protection against overcurrent, overheating, and overcharging—ensuring safe, stable power delivery at all times.
High Capacity Power Bank: The Portronics Power Shutter features a 10000mAh High Powerbank capacity, allowing you to charge your devices multiple times on the go.
22.5W Fast Charging: Equipped with a Type-C PD output that delivers up to 22.5W power for quick charging of smartphones, tablets, and other USB-C devices
15W Wireless Magnetic Charging: Supports 15W wireless charging Strong Suction, allowing you to simply attach compatible devices magnetically for cable-free charging.
In-built Charging Cables: Includes built-in Type-C and 8-pin output cables, ensuring you never have to carry extra cables. Perfect Powerbank for users with both Android and iOS devices.
Bidirectional Type-C Port: A bidirectional Type-C port allows for both input and output charging, making it versatile for recharging the power bank or charging your devices.
description: The Portronics Power Shutter Wireless Magnetic Power Bank is an innovative, high-capacity 10000mAh power solution designed for those who need reliable charging on the go. With its impressive 22.5W Type-C PD fast charging capability, it delivers quick power to smartphones, tablets, and other USB-C devices, ensuring minimal downtime. One of its standout features is the 15W wireless magnetic charging with strong suction, allowing users to magnetically attach compatible devices for effortless, cable-free charging. The power bank also boasts in-built Type-C and 8-pin output cables, providing convenience for both Android and iOS users without the need for extra cables. Its bidirectional Type-C port enables both input and output charging, making it versatile for recharging the power bank itself or for charging your devices. Constructed with high-grade EV batteries, the Power Shutter is built to last, supporting up to 1000 charging cycles for long-term use. Additionally, the LED digital display keeps you informed of the battery level at all times, displaying real-time charging status.
